gap_description: A youtube transcript downloader, when i paste a youtube url I want to be able to download the transcript .srt? file and convert it automaticly also to markdown, both files will be downloaded and use the other tool stash so it will be indexed and saved in the stash folder, I have yt-dlp installed via pip already
purpose: Fills the gap for downloading and converting YouTube transcripts to multiple formats, with automatic stash integration for indexing
capabilities: Convert SRT format to clean markdown
Save both .srt and .md files to stash automatically
Support any valid YouTube URL format

parameters.url: YouTube video URL (youtube.com or youtu.be format)
